description: OidcStore::validate_jwt iterates providers in a for loop, awaiting each provider's validate_jwt serially. For a multi-provider configuration (e.g. two OIDC IdPs), the second provider is not attempted until the first completes, including its JWKS fetch latency. Using tokio::select\! or futures::join_all with early-exit would allow concurrent provider attempts with first-match semantics. Impact at scale: negligible for 1-2 providers (common case), but O(n) latency for n providers on a cold cache.
title: oidc: validate_jwt iterates providers sequentially; no concurrency on multi-provider configs
